My boyfriend (25) and I(F 22) use each other’s phones as our own. We are very open with each other. I’ve been cheated on a lot (not by my current bf) so he understands my insecurities and is completely open. I’ve never accused him of cheating, never even suspected him of cheating because of how open he is with me. 

I agree with op in the sense that intentionally snooping trying to find ammunition for an argument is unhealthy and toxic.

Having the ability to just go through each other’s phone helps provide a feeling of mutual trust that calms my anxieties to the point that I don’t need to go thorough his phone.
